title: Swarm of Swarms: Evolutionary Functional & 2D/3D Spatial Causal Simulation for Embodied AI
description: Mathematical specification, AI Safety alignment framework, and zero-relay 2D/3D spatial causal simulation benchmarks (simulation_v5_1_2d.py, simulation_v6_0_3d.py) for Embodied AI and multi-agent swarm systems (achieving 4.57 +- 0.06 Bit/J in 2D and 3.73 +- 0.08 Bit/J in 3D).
notes: Developed and independently audited via a triadic Human-AI methodology (APPROVED verdict on v5.1 2D and v6.0.0 3D benchmarks).
